description: This file defines the NamingSeries class and related functions for managing naming series in the ERPNext system, including retrieving, updating, validating, and setting naming series options, as well as handling series insertion and parsing.

classes.name: NamingSeriesNotSetError
classes.description: Custom exception for unset naming series errors.

classes.name: NamingSeries
classes.description: Main class for managing naming series, including retrieving, updating, validating, inserting, and parsing series.

methods.name: get_transactions
methods.description: Retrieves available transactions and prefixes related to naming series.

methods.name: scrub_options_list
methods.description: Cleans and filters a list of options, removing empty or whitespace-only entries.

methods.name: update_series
methods.description: Updates the list of series options and creates missing series entries.

methods.name: validate_series_set
methods.description: Validates that a series is set when required.

methods.name: set_series_for
methods.description: Sets options for a given doctype's naming series property, including validation and cache clearing.

methods.name: check_duplicate
methods.description: Checks for duplicate naming series across different doctypes and raises errors if found.

methods.name: validate_series_name
methods.description: Validates that a series name contains only allowed characters.

methods.name: get_options
methods.description: Retrieves available options for a doctype's naming series field.

methods.name: get_current
methods.description: Fetches the current value of the series based on the prefix.

methods.name: insert_series
methods.description: Inserts a new series record if it does not already exist.

methods.name: update_series_start
methods.description: Updates the starting point of a series based on the current value.

methods.name: parse_naming_series
methods.description: Parses the naming series prefix, removing placeholders.
